reading_rule: Moment inversion, event accounting and distribution accuracy are separate checks. Reconstruction rounding bounds apply at validation time, including rejected trials; they do not bound subsequent nonlinear amplification. The SSPRK2 average preserves identical subnormal states algebraically. Smooth three-moment closures cannot reproduce arbitrary multimodal populations or discrete low-count capture. No full column, deposition, breakup, settling or moisture-history repair is exercised. Incomplete controls remain failures to establish adequacy. Number CDFs use original collector normalization. The reference variance is the unbiased sample variance of 8192 independent histories; candidate variance is its represented population variance. The DKW band is 95% uniform in mass at each saved time separately, not a joint 95% guarantee across times or controls. It describes sampling only and supplies endpoint compatibility, not closure convergence.
